facts.fact: FAO says the EOSTAT-Zimbabwe project, launched in 2023 with African Development Bank funding and implemented with the Ministry of Lands, Agriculture, Fisheries, Water and Rural Development, ZIMSTAT, ZINGSA and others, is rolling out an Earth-observation crop monitoring system and crop type and yield data practices.

systems.owner: FAO with the Ministry of Lands, Agriculture, Fisheries, Water and Rural Development
